About.metaDescription: Who we are: FGV-SP's quantitative finance student league, founded in 2021. Math, statistics and programming applied to markets.
About.title: Math, statistics and code to understand markets.
About.lead: FGV Quant is the quantitative finance student league at FGV-SP. Since {year}, about {members} members have studied, researched and built systematic strategies.

mission.title: Learn by doing, with rigour.
mission.p1: We produce content and go deeper into quantitative finance, applying mathematics, statistics and programming to real market problems.
mission.p2: Our method is PBL (Problem Based Learning): we learn by solving problems, from derivatives and machine learning to algorithmic trading and Python.

areas.title: Where we focus our study.
areas.description: Five fronts that combine theory, data and implementation.

how.title: From theory to practice.
how.description: A continuous cycle of study, research and market exposure.

study.title: Study groups
study.body: Sessions to go deeper into quantitative finance topics, with problems to solve together.

research.title: Research
research.body: Critical reading of academic literature and development of our own strategies and models.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.body: FGV Quant Insights, monthly, gathers analysis, strategies and news from the field.

fund.title: Simulated fund
fund.body: FGV Quant Capital is a simulated, educational fund used to test strategies.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.body: League teams take part in quantitative and investment challenges.

events.body: Meetups, talks and activities open to the community.
